svg.title: Dental LLM benchmark visual summary
svg.desc: Leaderboard, clinical error analysis, and judge agreement summary from a 30-question dental LLM benchmark.
svg.text: Which LLMs can a dentist trust?
30 clinician-reviewed dental questions · 8 frontier models · rubric-based judging
Deployment accuracy; refusals count as incorrect. Top-model intervals overlap — treat small ranking gaps cautiously.
Most common: treatment thresholds, pharmacology nuance, peri-implant evidence overstatement.
GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.5 second-judge passes showed moderate agreement with Claude Opus 4.8.
Raw answers, rubrics, judge verdicts, scripts, paper, and this report are public.
